label: MSSP program rules (quality, assignment, benchmark, advance payments)
choose: MSSP BASIC level A-E or MSSP ENHANCED

performance_standard.value: Report the APP Plus measure set and score at or above the 40th percentile of all MIPS Quality performance category scores

performance_standard_py2025_score.unit: MIPS Quality score (mean of PY2021-2023 40th percentiles)

ecqm_incentive.value: PY2025-2026: ACOs reporting all eCQMs/MIPS CQMs with data completeness meet the standard at >=10th percentile on one outcome measure and >=40th on one other; eCQMs only from PY2027

alternative_standard.value: At or above the 10th percentile on at least one APP Plus outcome measure: sharing rate scaled by the ACO's quality score (sliding scale)

enhanced_loss_effect.value: ENHANCED loss rate = 1 - 0.75 x quality score within 40-75%; 75% if neither standard met; BASIC C-E loss rate fixed at 30%

2027: adds 305 Initiation and Engagement of SUD Treatment

health_equity_quality_adjustment.value: Quality-score health equity adjustment applies PY2023-2025 only; removed starting PY2026

methods.unit: elected before each agreement period; may change annually

stepwise.value: Step 1 plurality of allowed primary care charges by primary care physicians/NPPs; Step 2 specialists for beneficiaries with no primary care practitioner service; Step 3 (PY2025+) expanded 24-month window for beneficiaries with a non-physician ACO professional service

voluntary_alignment.value: Beneficiary designation of an ACO professional assigns the beneficiary prospectively, regardless of track

regional_adjustment_positive_cap.unit: share of national per capita expenditure

regional_adjustment_negative_cap.unit: share of national per capita expenditure

acpt_weight.unit: Accountable Care Prospective Trend share of the three-way update factor (agreement periods from 2024)

risk_score_growth_cap.value: Aggregate demographic risk-score growth plus 3 percentage points (agreement periods from 2024); flat 3% before 2024

prior_savings_adjustment.value: Lesser of 50% of pro-rated average per capita savings or 5% of national per capita expenditure

hcc_model.value: Uses the CMS-HCC model(s) of the performance year for all benchmark years, following the MA phase-in (PY2024 67% V24/33% V28)

eligibility.value: New (not renewing/re-entering), inexperienced with risk, low-revenue ACOs entering the BASIC glide path at Level A

quarterly_per_beneficiary.unit: USD per assigned beneficiary per quarter by risk factor score (max 8 quarters, 10,000 beneficiaries)

recoupment.value: Recouped from any shared savings the ACO earns, carried into later agreement periods

prepaid_shared_savings.value: Renewing ACOs (agreement periods from 2026) with prior shared savings and a positive prior savings adjustment in Level C-E or ENHANCED; quarterly prepayment recouped from shared savings; >=50% to direct beneficiary services
